reviews.title: Works well on PS5
reviews.comment:
Got this for my PS5 and so far so good. Games that I moved over perform well on it (such as Resident Evil Remakes 2 & 4) and games like FF7 Rebirth.
For the price it's a good buy. No regrets.
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.title: looks great but measure your space to see if heatsink will fit
reviews.comment: The heatsink is large, much larger than I was anticipating. will not easily fit in a large HP Fury G9 Workstation. This limits the number of drives from 4 to 3 drives
